message.content: {"mentions":[{"ref":"m1","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":0},{"ref":"m2","surface":"閒人","occurrence":0},{"ref":"m3","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":1},{"ref":"m4","surface":"狀元","occurrence":0},{"ref":"m5","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":2},{"ref":"m6","surface":"酒店","occurrence":0},{"ref":"m7","surface":"土穀祠","occurrence":0},{"ref":"m8","surface":"樁家","occurrence":0},{"ref":"m9","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":3},{"ref":"m10","surface":"穿堂","occurrence":0},{"ref":"m11","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":4},{"ref":"m12","surface":"土穀祠","occurrence":1},{"ref":"m13","surface":"工作","occurrence":0}],"relations":[{"subject_ref":"m1","object_ref":"m2","type":"冲突","evidence":[{"quote":"但雖然是蟲豸，閒人也並不放，仍舊在就近什麽地方給他碰了五六個響頭，這纔心滿意足的得勝的走了，他以爲阿Q這回可遭了瘟。","occurrence":0}]},{"subject_ref":"m1","object_ref":"m8","type":"同伙","evidence":[{"quote":"樁家揭開盒子蓋，也是汗流滿面的唱。『天門啦～～角回啦！人和穿堂空在那裏啦～～！阿Q的銅錢拿過來～～！』","occurrence":3}]},{"subject_ref":"m1","object_ref":"m10","type":"同伙","evidence":[{"quote":"穿堂一百——一百五十！","occurrence":4}]},{"subject_ref":"m1","object_ref":"m1","type":"追求","evidence":[{"quote":"他覺得他是第一個能够自輕自賤的人，除了『自輕自賤』不算外，餘下的​就是『第一個』。狀元不也是『第一個』麽？『你算是什麽東西』呢！？","occurrence":1}]}],"alias_proposals":[]}
